title: Grace Found My Name
style: contemporary gospel ballad, inspirational soul, warm grand piano, Hammond organ swells, lush strings, mature soulful female vocal, rich gospel choir, 76 bpm, grateful, joyful, triumphant build
negativeTags: trap, EDM, rock, distorted, rap, country
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Gentle piano, humming choir)

[Verse 1]
I was standing at the back door
With my head bowed down in shame
I had lost my way so many times
I forgot my own name

[Pre-Chorus]
But a voice broke through the silence
And it called me by my name

[Chorus]
Grace found my name
When I was far away
Grace found my name
And washed the past away
I was lost in the crowd, but You called me out
Grace found my name

[Verse 2]
Now I'm sitting at the table
Where I never thought I'd be
With the robe and ring He gave me
And a love that set me free

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't have to earn the welcome
I just have to come on home

[Chorus]
Grace found my name
When I was far away
Grace found my name
And washed the past away
I was lost in the crowd, but You called me out
Grace found my name

[Bridge]
(Choir enters, building)
I'm not who I used to be, not who I used to be
You wrote a brand-new story over me
(Lead ad-libs over choir)

[Final Chorus]
(Key change, full choir)
Grace found my name
When I was far away
Grace found my name
And washed the past away
I was lost in the crowd, but You called me out
Grace found my name

[Outro]
(Piano and soft choir)
Grace found my name
